+from starlette.websockets import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, WebSocketDisconnected, WebSocketState
 from tests.types import TestClientFactory
 
 
+def test_websocket_disconnected_is_runtime_error() -> None:
+    assert issubclass(WebSocketDisconnected, RuntimeError)
+
+
 def test_websocket_url(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
     async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:

@@ -651,3 +655,70 @@ def test_receive_wrong_message_type(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> N
     with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
         with client.websocket_connect("/") as websocket:
             websocket.send({"type": "websocket.connect"})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_disconnected_low_level_operations() -> None:
+    messages: list[Message] = [
+        {"type": "websocket.connect"},
+        {"type": "websocket.disconnect", "code": 1000},
+    ]
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return messages.pop(0)
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    websocket = WebSocket({"type": "websocket", "path": "/"}, receive, send)
+    await websocket.receive()
+    await websocket.receive()
+    with pytest.raises(
+        WebSocketDisconnected,
+        match='Cannot call "receive" once a disconnect message has been received.',
+    ):
+        await websocket.receive()
+
+    await websocket.send({"type": "websocket.accept"})
+    await websocket.send({"type": "websocket.close"})
+    with pytest.raises(
+        WebSocketDisconnected,
+        match='Cannot call "send" once a close message has been sent.',
+    ):
+        await websocket.send({"type": "websocket.close"})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method_name", ["receive_text", "receive_bytes", "receive_json"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("application_state", [WebSocketState.CONNECTING, WebSocketState.DISCONNECTED])
+async def test_receive_helpers_when_application_not_connected(
+    method_name: str,
+    application_state: WebSocketState,
+) -> None:
+    async def receive() -> Message:  # pragma: no cover
+        raise AssertionError
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:  # pragma: no cover
+        raise AssertionError
+
+    websocket = WebSocket({"type": "websocket", "path": "/"}, receive, send)
+    websocket.application_state = application_state
+    with pytest.raises(
+        WebSocketDisconnected,
+        match='WebSocket is not connected. Need to call "accept" first.',
+    ):
+        await getattr(websocket, method_name)()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_receive_json_invalid_mode_is_runtime_error() -> None:
+    async def receive() -> Message:  # pragma: no cover
+        raise AssertionError
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:  # pragma: no cover
+        raise AssertionError
+
+    websocket = WebSocket({"type": "websocket", "path": "/"}, receive, send)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc:
+        await websocket.receive_json(mode="invalid")
+    assert type(exc.value) is RuntimeError
